panels.title: Reservations
panels.description: reserved is a new hold. replay is the same idempotency key. rejected means the conditional stock update found too little available stock. The database statement still enforces non-negative available stock.

panels.title: Expired reservations
panels.description: Held reservations released because they passed their expiry. The stock returns to available in the same transaction.

panels.title: Flash Sale
panels.description: Flash Sale admission and rejection counters are not emitted yet.

options.content: Flash Sale is not implemented. Admission and rejection series will be added with the campaign quota. Until then this dashboard only shows ordinary inventory reservations.
